reason: The primary CIF parses without warnings and symmetry-expands in primitive P-1 to six fully occupied ordered sites (Re2O2F2, reduced ReOF, Z=2) in the stated 5.373149 x 4.195954 x 3.656229 A, 89.076402/110.570951/111.505024 degree, 71.1995 A^3 cell; primitive standardization retains the same volume and atom count. Indexing is strong (20/20 selected lines, M20=238.2), and the lattice accounts for observed reflections through 90 degrees with no important extra line. Direct instantiation of the submitted CIF reproduces the trace's whole-profile residual R=0.03707 (rms 0.193), close to the auditable Le Bail/profile lower bound R=0.03276, so the support is atomic-intensity evidence rather than peak positions alone. Independent global searches converged on the same Re Patterson vector and centrosymmetric coordinates; a fully refined swapped O/F realization is materially worse (R=0.04747), while unconstrained P1 refinement has the same R and returns to inversion within 4e-9 fractional coordinate. Periodic shells contain no overlaps and give each Re a complete 3O+3F shell (Re-O 1.843-1.867 A; Re-F 1.894-2.188 A), with charge-balanced Re(III)/O(II-)/F(I-). Generic bond-valence sums are atypical, but without impossible contacts or a concrete diffraction-compatible alternative this is not a chemistry veto under the policy. No specific viable incompatible branch survives, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different candidate.
